tools.name: vrbo_reprice
tools.description: New Vrbo nightly, cleaning, and pet prices that keep host take-home the same after Vrbo's flat 12% fee (Oct 29, 2026). Rates are decimals.

tools.name: airbnb_host_only
tools.description: Airbnb price that keeps host payout the same when the split host fee (default 0.03) becomes the single host-only fee (default 0.155).

tools.name: price_match
tools.description: Direct, Airbnb, and Vrbo prices that all leave the host the same take-home per night.

tools.name: lead_window
tools.description: Days from first Vrbo contact to a direct booking, and whether it is inside the window (default 30 days, as industry reports describe Vrbo's terms).
